[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
More items are disqualifying if you add them to the Luau Soup – such as alcohol, poisonous, or very common items.
There is custom event dialogue, [b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Luau#Potluck]some consistency changes[/url][/b], and maybe a goofy easter egg or two. For fun.

Alternatively, you can use this mod to prank your friends in multiplayer.
If you have any suggestions, let me know. I might add them in as an update.
